Verification Summary Report — Amplitude Control

This report summarises the verification of the amplitude control requirements: for each requirement in its scope, the protocols that verify it, their executions and results. The procedures are in DOC-0004 and their executions are reported in DOC-0005.

A Verification Summary Report is a type of its own that extends Document: the matrix below is its template's, so every report of this type lays out its scope the same way, and the report itself holds only this prose and the requirements it covers.
